# ScopeFlux

> ScopeFlux (https://scopeflux.io) lists domain names that are about to expire, drop or go to a registry auction, with the date and the source of every listing. It also checks any single domain's registration status and expiration date. Free to use, no account needed. English interface.

ScopeFlux shows estimates published by public sources, not guarantees: a holder may renew a domain, and other buyers may register it the moment it is released. Always confirm availability with a registrar. ScopeFlux cannot register, reserve or buy domains.

## Pages

- [Expiring soon](https://scopeflux.io/): upcoming releases for .sk, .cz, .com, .net, .org, .io and .app, filterable by extension, date range (7 or 30 days), name length, hyphens, numbers and an estimated name quality.
- [Recently expired](https://scopeflux.io/#recent): listings whose release date passed in the last 30 days, kept from ScopeFlux's own archive.
- [Check domain](https://scopeflux.io/check-domain): registration status and expiration date of any domain, from public registry data (RDAP).
- [Sources](https://scopeflux.io/sources): every data source, what it covers and its limits.
- [About](https://scopeflux.io/about)
- [Privacy](https://scopeflux.io/privacy): no tracking cookies; cookieless visit counts (Cloudflare Web Analytics); optional sign-in only for the watchlist.
- [Contact](https://scopeflux.io/contact): hello@scopeflux.io

## Data sources

- .cz: the official CZ.NIC auction list. Expired .cz domains go to a public registry auction about 15 days after being listed; unsold names are released the day after the auction. ScopeFlux shows when bidding opens.
- .sk: Backorder.sk's public list of held .sk domains with their deletion days (date only, no hour).
- .com, .net, .org, .io, .app: Dynadot's public backorder listings with projected drop times.
- Single-domain checks: RDAP registries listed by IANA.

Lists refresh about every hour. Coverage is partial: these are public previews, not complete registry dumps.

## Data access

- JSON: `https://scopeflux.io/api/domains?cached=1&tlds=cz` returns the saved upcoming listings for one or more extensions (comma-separated: sk, cz, com, net, org, io, app). Each record has domain, tld, status, drop (release date or time, ISO 8601), source and sourceUrl.
- JSON: `https://scopeflux.io/api/domains?domain=example.com` checks one domain.
- Please cache results and keep request rates low.
